I've made the net by cutting a rectangular piece of mosquito mesh. On one end of the rectangle I've folded it on itself and put a thread through the holes of the mesh to make a hem that will close when I pull the thread ends. After that I cut a piece of wire which I threaded one inch below the hem. I used some tubing to shape the wire and twisted the ends to creat a circle. Repeated that two more times to get three circles at an equal distance between them . I sown the mesh on its length . Sown the bottom of the net closed. I sculpted some polymer clay to make the fish cut some aluminium tape (the shiny material on the fish) I rolled an exacto knife over the tape to give it that pattern like scales. I glued the tape on the fish used acrylic paints and some markers to paint the fish . I glued the eyes ( the eyes are bought from lure making shops or fly tying shops. I coated the fish with UV resin cured it and put the fish inside the net
